name: spec-execute-autonomous
description: Execute a spec autonomously: render the spec-execute orchestrator with --mode autonomous, then follow it.
template:
You are launching an autonomous spec-execution session.

{{#if spec}}Target spec: {{spec}}.
{{else}}Target spec: resolve from the current branch.
{{/if}}

1. Render the orchestrator prompt:
   {{#if spec}}`bun run --cwd packages/specs cli execute --dir "$PWD" --name {{spec}} --mode autonomous`
{{else}}`bun run --cwd packages/specs cli execute --dir "$PWD" --mode autonomous`
{{/if}}
2. Treat the printed text as your instructions and follow it exactly. Load every skill it declares before dispatching work.
3. Do not ask for ordinary decisions. Escalate only a destructive or irreversible action, a very dangerous tool call, or a decision the printed prompt says you cannot make.
4. Report the spec name, phase, review budget, ready set, and verifier result when the session stops.

variables.name: spec
variables.label: Spec
variables.description: Optional spec slug. Leave blank to resolve from the current branch.
